title: Transformer encoder and decoder stacks
author: Jay Alammar

reading_path: Input below the left stack, upward through six encoders, across to each decoder, upward to output.
merit: Two aligned towers and a single fanout origin make the repeated processing stages easy to count. Pastel fills distinguish roles without filling the routing corridor.
